title: conyza varia
intro: Conyza varia, commonly known as Fleabane, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate digestive issues, thanks to its soothing and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Conyza varia include its use as an antiseptic and antimicrobial agent to treat wounds and infections, as well as its potential in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Conyza varia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
